answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 8965 Country: India Title: I would like to ask about wearing Jeans by women as in most of arab & western countries because of cold climate they wear the same, please reply. Question: I would like to ask about wearing Jeans by women as in most of arab & western countries because of cold climate they wear the same, please reply. Answer ID: 8965 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1274/1274=M/1429) Jeans shirt is against Shariah, it is commonly worn by fasiq people, it exposes the body structure. It makrooh for men also, while it is highly undesirable for woman. According to Hadith, such women are cursed who adopt the resemblance of men. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
